Delta D: Dose criterion of the gamma analysis, a percentage of the plan's maximum dose
Delta d: Distance criterion of the gamma analysis
Gamma: Gamma index of a measured point: its combined distance and dose disagreement with the plan, in units of the criteria
R: CSDA range of protons in water
delta: Difference between the measured dose and the plan's dose at that plan point
r: Distance from the measured point to a point of the plan
sigma: Spot size in the phantom, the standard deviation of the spot's dose across the beam
sigma_MCS: Lateral spread added by multiple Coulomb scattering in the phantom
sigma_air: Spot size at isocenter in air, before the phantom
